page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the processor delivers modest compute capabilities, with single-core and multi-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores falling into the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth for large, uncached blocks is average, reaching 39.75 GB/sec for read operations and 36.51 GB/sec for write operations, though small-block cached memory bandwidth is weak. Cryptographic and compression tasks show lower efficiency, with single-threaded gzip compression rated in the bottom 10%. However, the instance maintains average performance for Redis SET operations and small-model LLM inference.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.se1.2xlarge offers a cost-efficient profile for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-performance compute or local NVMe storage. The high RAM capacity relative to the vCPU count makes it suitable for hosting in-memory caches, lightweight databases, and memory-bound application servers where raw processing speed is secondary to memory footprint.
